checks.name: stable-render
args:
from pathlib import Path
import json
import subprocess
import sys

helper, source, output_path = sys.argv[1:]
output = Path(output_path)
command = [sys.executable, helper, source, output_path]
subprocess.run(command, check=True)
first = output.read_bytes()
subprocess.run(command, check=True)
assert output.read_bytes() == first
path = Path(source)
data = json.loads(path.read_text())
data["ports"].reverse()
data["allowlist"].reverse()
path.write_text(json.dumps(data, sort_keys=True))
subprocess.run(command, check=True)
assert output.read_bytes() == first
print("stable across rerender and reordered input")
checks.expectedStdout: stable across rerender and reordered input

checks.name: reject-boolean-port
args:
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys

helper, input_path, output_path, message = sys.argv[1:]
output = Path(output_path)
output.write_bytes(b"preserve existing output\n")
result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, helper, input_path, output_path], capture_output=True, text=True)
assert result.returncode == 2, result
assert result.stdout == "", result
assert result.stderr == f"render_sshd: {message}\n", result
assert output.read_bytes() == b"preserve existing output\n"
print("rejected; output preserved")
port must be an integer from 1 to 65535
